device.description: 12-bit 333 kHz sampling ADC, +/-10 V or +/-5 V input, 12-bit or 8+4-bit parallel bus with R/C, HBE and BUSY
device.note: ads7800.pdf (SBAS001A) p.2 specifications (VS 4.75-5.25 V, conversion time 2.7 us max, offset binary coding), p.4 pin assignments, p.7 Table I acquisition/conversion timing, Table II control line functions, conversion start, p.8 reading data, p.9 Table III timing

pages: p.2 (specifications: VS = VSA = VSD 4.75-5.25 V, conversion time 2.5 typ / 2.7 us max, data coding binary offset binary, VIH to +5.3 V), p.4 (pin assignments, DIP/SOIC same numbering), p.6-7 (R/C convert and read modes, Table I tB 2.7 us, tC 2.70 us max, Table II control line functions, HBE 8+4-bit read), p.7 (conversion start), p.8 (reading data: R/C high, BUSY high, CS low), p.9 (Table III: tDD 150 ns max data valid, tHL 150 ns max to Hi-Z)
notModeled: analog inputs (+/-10 V on IN1, +/-5 V on IN2) and the 2 V reference output: the result is always the 0 V code 800h (offset binary)

conversion start gating: the R/C falling edge starts a conversion only when CS is low, HBE is low and BUSY is high (falling edges during a conversion are ignored); the model starts one on every R/C falling edge
outputs stay Hi-Z while BUSY is low (conversion in progress) even with CS low and R/C high; the model drives the read pattern whenever CS is low and R/C is high
with HBE high the datasheet only states that pins 14-17 carry D11-D8 and pins 9-12 are forced low; pins 5-8 (D11-D8) are modeled as still carrying the 4 MSBs
Read mode (positive R/C pulse: previous result enabled while R/C is high) and Convert mode differ only in timing; both follow from the R/C level
tDBC BUSY delay (150 ns max) after R/C falls, tDB BUSY delay after data valid, tS/tH setup and hold of CS/HBE around R/C, acquisition time 300 ns
supplies: -VS (-11.4 to -16.5 V) is analog-only; VSD and VSA must be tied together
variants: single-device datasheet; grades J/K (SOIC DW) and A/B (CDIP SB JDN) differ in accuracy only. ADS7800AH (JDN, active in the Package Option Addendum) is not in the skeleton parts list.
